criteria_covered.board_action_admin_only_with_confirmatio: NOT covered here: the request names no component or prop, so a blind web test would be a guess. Belongs to the web slice.

decisions_pinned: A second delete-all on the same etapa answers 200 with deletedCount 0 and skippedConvertedCount still counting live converted cards; it writes nothing.
A lead restored on its own (or restored and deleted again on its own) leaves the batch: the batch restore skips it and does not audit it twice.
Batch restore keeps restoreLead's rules: own etapa if still active, else the first open etapa with one stage_changed event; appended at the end in the original order; column dense.
Batch restore is admin-only, like the deleted list.
not_run_here: The suite needs the local Docker Postgres (TEST_DATABASE_URL, ADMIN_DATABASE_URL, TEST_MIGRATE_DATABASE_URL); this sandbox has none, so the expected Red was not observed. The config loads and stops at globalSetup on the missing URLs.
